contract.purpose: Practical Web Audio versus KesshoCore browser acceptance corpus for core migration parity.
contract.sharedStartRequirement: Strict pad/manual-note cases are runnable now. Self-running drum and earth cases are gated with transient/envelope scoring for browser/core scheduling jitter.

padSlice.label: Pad Slice
padSlice.target: Core pad source is close enough for migration of pad-only playback.
padSlice.passDefinition: Dry pad, Pad 2, and shared reverb-tail gates pass with shared-start manual pad notes and no page errors.
padSlice.boundaryDefinition: No open pad-slice boundary case remains after deterministic pre-reverb conditioning and input-synchronous reverb reset.

fxSlice.label: FX Slice
fxSlice.target: Core shared FX and master chain are close enough when fed by pad/manual deterministic input.
fxSlice.passDefinition: All required close/perceptual cases pass, using envelope gates for feedback-heavy tails where sample correlation is not meaningful.

sourceSlice.label: Source Slice
sourceSlice.target: Core non-pad sources are close enough for lead, drums, and earth/soundscape migration.
sourceSlice.passDefinition: All deterministic source cases pass; stochastic drum and earth cases pass documented transient/envelope gates.

fullMixSlice.label: Full Mix Slice
fullMixSlice.target: Core is close enough for representative webapp states and migration can proceed.
fullMixSlice.passDefinition: Full-mix cases have no block failures, no silent enabled sources, and pass scoped perceptual/manual-review scoring.

thresholdClasses.exact: Deterministic dry or nearly dry source. Expect tight RMS/peak thresholds and stable correlation.
thresholdClasses.close: Deterministic source through FX. Some phase/tail drift is acceptable within thresholds.
thresholdClasses.perceptual: Complex, stochastic, or feedback-heavy path. Thresholds catch gross drift; reviewer checks lag, level, and obvious character.
thresholdClasses.manual-review: Acceptance requires listening or repeated-run judgement even if numeric thresholds pass.

knownExclusionsDebt: This is browser Web Audio versus core-wasm acceptance only; macOS/iOS device CPU, battery, route-change, and screen-off behavior stay outside this gate.
The corpus does not require bit-exact parity. It is meant to decide when core-wasm is close enough for migration.
Earth/soundscape, drum sequencer, granular feedback, and full-mix cases use envelope or transient gates instead of bit-exact waveform correlation.
Lead manual-note cases require core-wasm lead trigger support in the parity harness.
Preset storage/cloud round-trip validation is out of scope here; cases use local states and local factory preset references.

pass: The parity script exits 0 for every required expected-pass corpus case.
Reference Web RMS is at or above each case minSignalRms.
Normalized RMS/peak sample differences or the configured transient/envelope gate are within the per-case thresholds.
The run has no page errors, non-finite samples, or unexpected silent captures.
review: Best-lag magnitude above 50 ms, even if RMS passes.
Correlation below 0.85 on deterministic manual-note cases.
Any stochastic earth/granular case that passes only with visibly unstable metrics between repeated runs.
block: Silent reference capture on an enabled source.
Any deterministic expected-pass source case above threshold.
Browser console/page errors from the parity harness or core host.

cases.title: Simple dry pad
cases.intent: Small deterministic pad chord with no shared FX; this stays a waveform parity sentinel for the richer pad blend.
readyWhen: pad manual notes work in both engines

cases.title: Default pad dry
cases.intent: The unadorned app-default pad sustain path, dried out so it is a stable migration gate without conflating the 12s release tail.
readyWhen: pad manual notes work in both engines

cases.title: Default Pad 2 dry
cases.intent: The same dry sustain gate through Pad 2 voice assignment and route selection.
readyWhen: pad2 manual notes route to the assigned Pad 2 voice in both engines

cases.title: Pad plus long reverb tail
cases.intent: Same musical role as the dry pad, but with the shared reverb return and tail behavior active.
readyWhen: shared reverb return is represented in the core host

cases.title: Dense dark pad
cases.intent: Represents the darker, slower stock state used by the existing golden profile.
readyWhen: pad source and reverb path are stable

cases.title: Manual dry lead
cases.intent: Single-source 4-op lead timbre without pad, delay, or reverb masking.
readyWhen: manual lead1 trigger support exists for core-wasm parity capture

cases.title: Lead into heavy Delay A
cases.intent: High-feedback shared Delay A with a lead source, including ping-pong width and reverb send.
readyWhen: manual lead1 trigger support exists
Delay A module is represented in core-wasm capture

cases.title: Manual dry Lead 2 Gamelan
cases.intent: Lead 2 route and Gamelan endpoint preset parity without Lead 1, delay, or reverb masking.
readyWhen: manual lead2 trigger support exists for core-product parity capture
Lead 2 endpoint preset routing is not silent

cases.title: Manual dry Lead 2 Soft Rhodes
cases.intent: Lead 2 route and Soft Rhodes endpoint preset parity without Lead 1, delay, or reverb masking.
readyWhen: manual lead2 trigger support exists for core-product parity capture
Lead 2 Soft Rhodes endpoint preset routing is not silent

cases.title: Manual dry piano
cases.intent: Sampled piano dry source parity. Core mode uses a bounded host-side sample bridge so piano no longer goes silent while keeping idle Core CPU unchanged.
readyWhen: manual piano trigger support exists for core-wasm parity capture

cases.title: Synth Euclid lead grid
cases.intent: Self-running synth Euclidean lead route, verifying Core turns the sequencer lanes into repeating lead note events with web-style grid alignment.
readyWhen: Core host generates synth Euclidean notes and the worklet honors the initial join-grid delay

cases.title: Pad into ping-pong Delay A
cases.intent: Delay-heavy case that still uses current pad manual trigger support.
readyWhen: pad Delay A send and Delay A return are represented in core-wasm capture

cases.title: Pad delay into reverb bloom
cases.intent: Representative combined FX case: pad excites Delay A, the delay return feeds shared reverb, and both tails must stay sane.
readyWhen: Delay A and shared reverb return are both represented in core-wasm capture

cases.title: Pad-fed granular cloud
cases.intent: Pad source routed through the granular bus with a modest reverb return.
readyWhen: granular bus routing is available in core-wasm capture

cases.title: Delay returns through granular
cases.intent: Exercises cross-routing where the delay path becomes a granular input rather than only a wet return.
readyWhen: Delay A to granular and granular return routing are represented in core-wasm capture

cases.title: Tight Euclidean drum kit
cases.intent: Self-running drum source without delay masking; catches transient timing and level drift.
readyWhen: shared-start capture aligns self-running drum sequencer between engines

cases.title: Dubbed-out drum delay
cases.intent: Representative drum transients plus feedback delay smear.
readyWhen: shared-start capture aligns self-running drum sequencer
drum delay path is represented

cases.title: Water-only earth bed
cases.intent: Simple self-running earth layer with only water enabled.
readyWhen: shared-start capture seeds earth texture scheduling consistently

cases.title: Full nature earth kit
cases.intent: The broadest earth/soundscape state in the corpus, with multiple stochastic layers.
readyWhen: shared-start capture seeds earth texture scheduling consistently

cases.title: Ocean bed plus sparse pad
cases.intent: Hybrid musical pad and soundscape layer based on an existing full-state preset.
readyWhen: shared-start capture handles pad manual trigger and ocean sample scheduling

cases.title: Pad through dynamics and master chain
cases.intent: Master-chain acceptance case covering Dynamics page character/degrade/saturation/end compressor plus master saturation.
readyWhen: dynamics and master-chain routing are represented in core-wasm capture

cases.title: Gamelan full mix
cases.intent: Mixed melodic, lead, drum, delay, and reverb state from an existing preset, scoped to manual synth triggers plus the represented drum backbone.
readyWhen: shared-start capture covers manual pad/lead notes, drum sequencer output, delay, and reverb

cases.title: Dark ambient full mix
cases.intent: Dense acceptance endpoint: pad, granular, drum pulse, earth bed, and reverb all active.
readyWhen: shared-start capture covers sequencers, granular routing, earth scheduling, and reverb
